related.title: Fermi 伽瑪射線望遠鏡
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付有向圖、零點定義、重建值及閉合殘差，保留原始差分。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver directed graph,gauge,reconstructed values and closure residuals while retaining raw differences.
related.difference: 以有效面積和活時間估算光子通量，區分事件數、計數率及曝光。
related.differenceEn: Estimate photon flux from effective area and live time,distinguishing counts,count rate and exposure.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 設 C=0，依兩差值求 A、B，再用第三差值獨立查核。
算曝光 10⁷ cm²s，再以淨事件數除以曝光，與每秒計數率比較。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Set C=0,solve A and B from two differences and check the third independently.
Compute exposure 10⁷ cm²s,then divide net counts by exposure and compare with count rate.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Pioneer 深空探測計畫
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付有向圖、零點定義、重建值及閉合殘差，保留原始差分。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver directed graph,gauge,reconstructed values and closure residuals while retaining raw differences.
related.difference: 估算非對稱熱輻射的反衝加速度，檢查微小系統力如何累積成追蹤殘差。
related.differenceEn: Estimate recoil acceleration from asymmetric thermal radiation and examine accumulation of small systematic forces.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 設 C=0，依兩差值求 A、B，再用第三差值獨立查核。
先求 F=2×10⁻⁷ N，再除質量，核對 W/c 的力單位。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Set C=0,solve A and B from two differences and check the third independently.
Calculate F=2×10⁻⁷ N,divide by mass and verify that W/c has force units.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
